launch_authority: Parent agent only; no GPU launched by preparation.
execution_order: For each branch: full bounded train, chronological snapshot det/stoch evaluations, CPU critics at update2000 and final. Queue executes serially; only parent launches.
dependency_note: depends_on is documentation, not enforced by the runner. Missing upstream files make downstream CLI fail; no fallback training. Existing completion markers are reused; partial training output roots refuse overwrite and require manual inspection.

scientific_contrast.initialization: BC mean + calibrated unit-normalized std head; fresh random critic/target/temp. Diagnostic warmstart, not SAC from scratch.
scientific_contrast.unchanged: Native observation/action/reward/reset/termination/replay/update/BN/normalization/entropy recipe. The isolated wrapper gates actor+temperature only during warmup.

baseline_reuse.success: 128/128 on fixed seed0 reset/noise protocol before any learning
baseline_reuse.update0: Full native update0 snapshots retained for both branches. Existing selected-checkpoint frozen stochastic rollout reused, not rerun.
baseline_reuse.extra_gate_status: Seed1 and independent-noise gates tested separately by parent; not claimed completed here.

continue_limits: Selected std head is a diagnostic expert-data initialization. Expert-state tanh conditional entropy H is approximately -142 nats versus native Gaussian target about -13.87; alpha=.01 implies a substantial negative soft-return term. Good task performance does not imply the native maximum-entropy objective prefers keeping this policy.
Critic-only warmup freezes both actor and temperature, including BN, optimizer and scheduler. Native critic/target BN, reward normalization and replay keep changing.
This is online policy-protection versus immediate SAC updating, not offline frozen-dataset Q calibration. Protecting the actor also changes future collected data.

At equal environment budget warmup2000 has approximately1000 fewer actor/temp update opportunities and different actor/temp LR schedule positions. Report actual attempted and optimizer updates from audits, not only vector steps.

Native first vector action is random and native training initial episode progress is spread across the horizon, even with a loaded actor. Frozen evaluation has its own reset protocol; early training mismatch remains part of the native workflow.

Snapshot evals are fixed single-task, seed0 paired diagnostics, not generalization or 24-task paper results. Native stochastic uses global cached/repeated zeta noise; independent noise validation is separate.
Critic reports are phase-balanced inference/gradient/target diagnostics. Expert/native rollout files are not training replay; no true-return ranking or exact Q calibration is established.

Continue native settings unchanged only for this bounded diagnostic; monitor retention, temperature, entropy and lower/upper categorical clipping. A decline alone cannot isolate bad Q versus entropy pressure versus distribution shift.
Hard stop 09:00 local is enforced by the existing queue. Only queue-owned child processes may be terminated; unrelated work must not be touched.
